<div class="guide-frame">
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><strong>Web page</strong></div><span class="guide-side">→</span><div class="guide-box"><svg class="guide-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 -960 960 960" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M200-200h520v-184l45-22q16-8 25.5-22t9.5-32q0-17-9.5-31.5T765-514l-45-21v-185H528l-10-68q-3-22-19.5-37T460-840q-23 0-39.5 15T401-788l-10 68H200v86q56 21 88 68t32 106q0 60-32 107t-88 68v85Zm0 80q-34 0-57-23t-23-57v-152q48 0 84-30.5t36-77.5q0-46-36-76t-84-32v-152q0-33 23.5-56.5T200-800h122q7-51 46-85.5t92-34.5q52 0 91 34.5t47 85.5h122q33 0 56.5 23.5T800-720v134q36 18 58 52t22 74q0 41-22 75t-58 51v134q0 34-23.5 57T720-120H200Zm300-340Z"/></svg><strong>Extension</strong></div></div>
<div class="guide-down">↓</div>
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><strong>Relay program</strong><span>carries sealed messages, holds no keys</span></div></div>
<div class="guide-down">↓</div>
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><svg class="guide-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 -960 960 960" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M40-120v-80h880v80H40Zm120-120q-33 0-56.5-23.5T80-320v-440q0-33 23.5-56.5T160-840h640q33 0 56.5 23.5T880-760v440q0 33-23.5 56.5T800-240H160Zm0-80h640v-440H160v440Zm0 0v-440 440Z"/></svg><strong>WM Pass</strong><span>answers only for the site you are on</span></div></div>
</div>
<figcaption>The extension and the app talk over an encrypted link, set up once by comparing a fingerprint.</figcaption>
</figure>

#### Why it is there

Without it, the extension needs a vault of its own, with its own password to type and its own copy to keep in step.

#### How it works

In the app, open Settings, Browser extension. Turn on [Let the extension connect](/guide/settings/browser/#setting-bridge-enabled), then choose **Set up browsers**, which registers WM Pass with Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Chromium and Firefox.

In the extension, open Settings, Desktop app, and choose **Connect**. Both show a six-digit code. If they match, say so on both.

From then on the extension asks the app for the logins that match the page in front of you, and for the one you choose to fill. It cannot read the rest of the vault.

The two talk over an encrypted channel, through a small relay program that holds no keys. Each side commits to its part of the code before it sees the other's, so someone in the middle gets one chance in a million.

With [Ask before the first fill on each site](/guide/settings/browser/#setting-bridge-ask-every-site) on, the app asks once for each site before the first fill there.

#### When to use it

When you use the desktop app and a browser on the same computer.

#### Limits

The extension's own key is sealed by a browser key that scripts cannot read out, which stops a copied browser profile from connecting. It does not stop code running as the extension itself.

The app's question names the extension and where it says it comes from. Anything on the computer could claim the same, so refuse a request you did not start.

Passkeys, and the copy buttons in the toolbar popup, need the extension's own vault.

Forget an extension under **Connected extensions** to cut it off, including a conversation it already has open.

See also [Browser extension](/guide/settings/browser/), [Desktop app](/guide/settings/desktop-link/), [Let the extension connect](/guide/settings/browser/#setting-bridge-enabled), [Ask before the first fill on each site](/guide/settings/browser/#setting-bridge-ask-every-site), [Filling logins](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-autofill).

<a id="feature-autotype"></a>

## Typing logins with auto-type

*Only in the desktop app.*

Auto-type types a login's username, a Tab and its password into the window you were using, as if you typed them. It starts from quick search.

<figure class="guide-figure">
<div class="guide-frame">
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><strong>Quick search</strong><span>Shift+Enter on a login</span></div></div>
<div class="guide-down">↓</div>
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box warn"><strong>System input</strong><span>other programs can see it</span></div></div>
<div class="guide-down">↓</div>
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><strong>The window in front</strong><span>username, Tab, password</span></div></div>
</div>
<figcaption>Auto-type presses the keys for you. Typed text passes through the system, where other programs can see it.</figcaption>
</figure>

#### Why it is there

Some programs and remote desktops cannot be filled and will not take a paste. Typing reaches them, and skips the clipboard.

#### How it works

Turn on [Auto-type](/guide/settings/desktop/#setting-auto-type-enabled) under Settings, Desktop.

Open [Quick search window](/guide/screens/#screen-palette), find the login, and press Shift+Enter. WM Pass hides its windows, waits a moment for the window behind to take focus, then types.

It types the username, presses Tab, then types the password. It does not press Enter, so you can look before you sign in.

The password is read and typed by the app itself, outside the window's page.

#### When to use it

For apps the browser extension cannot reach, such as a desktop program or a remote session.

#### Limits

Typed text goes through the system's input queue, where other programs can see it.

It types into whichever window has the focus. If another window comes to the front in that moment, that window gets the password.

macOS asks for Accessibility permission the first time. On Linux it works under X11; Wayland desktops usually refuse it.

With [Lock when the window is hidden](/guide/settings/security/#setting-lock-on-hide) on, the vault locks once the main window is hidden, and quick search then has nothing to type.

See also [Auto-type](/guide/settings/desktop/#setting-auto-type-enabled), [Quick search window](/guide/screens/#screen-palette), [Quick search](/guide/settings/desktop/#setting-global-palette), [Copying secrets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-clipboard).

<a id="feature-ssh"></a>

## The SSH agent

*Only in the desktop app.*

While the vault is open, WM Pass can answer ssh and git for the SSH keys in it, so you sign in to servers with no key file on disk.

<figure class="guide-figure">
<div class="guide-frame">
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><svg class="guide-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 -960 960 960" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M160-160q-33 0-56.5-23.5T80-240v-480q0-33 23.5-56.5T160-800h640q33 0 56.5 23.5T880-720v480q0 33-23.5 56.5T800-160H160Zm0-80h640v-400H160v400Zm140-40-56-56 103-104-104-104 57-56 160 160-160 160Zm180 0v-80h240v80H480Z"/></svg><strong>ssh or git</strong></div></div>
<div class="guide-down">↓</div>
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><strong>Agent socket</strong><span>SSH_AUTH_SOCK</span></div></div>
<div class="guide-down">↓</div>
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box"><strong>WM Pass asks you</strong><span>if that is on</span></div></div>
<div class="guide-down">↓</div>
<div class="guide-row"><div class="guide-box good"><strong>Signed</strong><span>with a key from the vault</span></div></div>
</div>
<figcaption>The key signs inside WM Pass and never leaves the vault. When the vault locks, the agent has nothing to offer.</figcaption>
</figure>

#### Why it is there

A private key file in your home folder can be copied by any program. Kept in the vault, the key is encrypted on disk and used only while the vault is open.

#### How it works

Turn on [Run the SSH agent](/guide/settings/ssh/#setting-ssh-agent) under Settings, SSH agent. The page then shows a line to paste into your shell, which points SSH\_AUTH\_SOCK at WM Pass. It shows the exact line for your system.

The agent offers every SSH key item with **Offer to the SSH agent** turned on. Programs can list those keys and ask for a signature; they cannot add or remove keys through it.

With [Ask before each use](/guide/settings/ssh/#setting-ssh-confirm) on, a window asks each time a program wants a key to sign something, naming the key. Choose **Allow** or **Refuse**.

When the vault locks, the agent has nothing to offer until you unlock again.

In an SSH key item, **Generate a key** makes a new Ed25519 key. Only Ed25519 keys can sign through the agent. A key with a passphrase is opened with the passphrase saved in its item.

#### When to use it

When you use ssh, or git over SSH, on this computer and would rather your keys lived in the vault.

#### Limits

Any program running under your account can reach the agent. **Ask before each use** is what stops one from signing quietly, and its window names the key, not the program.

Keys on the hidden shelf or in the trash are never offered.

See also [SSH agent](/guide/settings/ssh/), [Run the SSH agent](/guide/settings/ssh/#setting-ssh-agent), [Ask before each use](/guide/settings/ssh/#setting-ssh-confirm), [Kinds of item](/guide/how-it-works/#concept-item-kinds).

<a id="feature-themes"></a>

## Themes and colors

A theme sets WM Pass's colors, how round its corners are, and its font. Pick one of the built-in themes, or make and share your own.

#### How it works

On the [Theme](/guide/settings/themes/) page, choose from WM Pass, High contrast, Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Solarized, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night and more. A theme can have a light side, a dark side or both, and [Dark mode](/guide/settings/look/#setting-look) picks which one you see.

Choose **New theme**, or **Customize a copy…** from a theme's menu, to make one of your own. Saving a built-in theme makes a copy, so the original stays as it was.

**Share…** gives a theme as a file or as a line of text to copy. **Import** takes either.

Whatever a theme says, WM Pass keeps text readable against its background, so a careless or unkind theme cannot hide a warning.

#### Limits

A theme holds colors and a few settings. Nothing from your vault is in it.

Themes use the same format on the phone and the computer, so a theme shared from one opens on the other.

See also [Theme](/guide/settings/themes/), [Style and theme](/guide/settings/look/), [Dark mode](/guide/settings/look/#setting-look).

<a id="feature-lock-tile"></a>

## Lock WM Pass tile

*Only in Android.*

A Quick Settings tile that locks the vault with one tap. It is lit while the vault is open.

#### How it works

Edit the tiles in your phone's Quick Settings and add **Lock WM Pass**.

A tap saves anything not yet saved and forgets every key, as locking inside the app does.

See also [Panic lock tile](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-panic-tile), [Locking](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-locking), [Lock after no activity](/guide/settings/security/#setting-lock-after).

<a id="feature-panic-tile"></a>

## Panic lock tile

*Only in Android.*

A Quick Settings tile that locks the vault at once and refuses every password for an hour.

#### How it works

Edit the tiles in your phone's Quick Settings and add **Panic lock**. It works whether or not the vault is open.

#### When to use it

When the phone may be taken from you while the vault is open, or you are about to hand it over and want it to stay shut for a while.

#### Limits

Nothing is erased. After the hour the vault opens with your password as usual.

See also [Lock and refuse passwords now](/guide/settings/security/#action-panic-now), [Lockout password](/guide/settings/security/#action-lockout-password), [When a panic app signals](/guide/settings/security/#setting-panic-action), [Lock WM Pass tile](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-lock-tile).

<a id="feature-app-shortcuts"></a>

## App shortcuts

*Only in Android.*

Touch and hold the WM Pass icon to go straight to **Search**, **Add a login**, **Codes** or **Generate**.

#### How it works

**Add a login** opens the add menu. If the vault is locked, the door comes first, then the page you picked.

See also [Widgets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-home-widget).

<a id="feature-share-to-pass"></a>

## Sharing to WM Pass

*Only in Android.*

Other apps can share text, pictures and PDFs to WM Pass. Text appears in the share sheet as **Save to WM Pass**, and pictures and PDFs as **Keep in WM Pass**.

#### How it works

- A web link searches the vault for its site, so you can see what is saved there.
- A one-time code link, one that starts with otpauth://, opens a new code with its details filled in. Tapping such a link in another app does the same.
- Any other text opens a new note with the text in it.
- A picture or a PDF becomes a new document item, named after the file, with the file attached.

If the vault is locked, the door comes first.

<a id="feature-launch-guard"></a>

## If the app keeps closing

*Only in Android.*

If WM Pass closes by itself within a few seconds of opening, twice in a row, the next launch puts Appearance back to the standard style.

#### Why it is there

A setting that makes the app crash as soon as it draws would otherwise leave clearing the app's storage as the only way out, and that deletes the vault.

#### How it works

The style, theme, animations, the app, site and settings icons, and the list layout go back to how they started. The door says why.

Your vault, dark mode, accent and your other settings stay as they were. Leaving the app, locking it, the screen going off or swiping it away never counts.

See also [Appearance](/guide/settings/appearance/), [Style and theme](/guide/settings/look/).

<a id="feature-home-widget"></a>

## Widgets

*Only in Android and the desktop app.*

Widgets for the home screen on a phone, and for the desktop and Notification Centre on a Mac.

#### Why it is there

Anyone who can see the screen can see a widget. So no widget names a site or shows a code unless you turn on [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access), and even then only while the vault is open.

#### How it works

- *Quick bar*: the buttons you choose under [Quick bar](/guide/settings/widgets/#setting-widget-buttons). Search, add, codes, generator and health open WM Pass on that page, after the door if the vault is locked. Lock locks the vault without opening WM Pass.
- *Lock status*: whether the vault is open, and its name while it is. A tap locks it, or opens the door.
- *Health*: your score and how many passwords are weak, reused or in a known breach. The counts are kept from the last time the vault was open, with when that was.
- *Backups*: when each backup place last ran, and whether that failed or the next run is late.
- *Generator*: a tap copies a new password made the way the generator is set up. Nothing is shown, and the clipboard is cleared as usual.
- *Codes* and *Favorites*: only with [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access) on, and only while the vault is open. Codes shows the codes chosen under [Codes on widgets](/guide/settings/widgets/#setting-widget-codes), and a tap copies one. Favorites shows a letter and a name for each favorite, and a tap opens it.

#### Limits

The Health counts are those of the vault opened last. A wipe password erases them along with the vault.

#### On Android

Touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, choose **Widgets**, then WM Pass.

- *Quick bar*: the buttons you choose under [Quick bar](/guide/settings/widgets/#setting-widget-buttons). Search, add, codes, generator and health open WM Pass on that page, after the door if the vault is locked. Lock locks the vault without opening WM Pass.
- *Lock status*: whether the vault is open, and its name while it is. A tap locks it, or opens the door.
- *Health*: your score and how many passwords are weak, reused or in a known breach. The counts are kept from the last time the vault was open, with when that was.
- *Backups*: when each backup place last ran, and whether that failed or the next run is late.
- *Generator*: a tap copies a new password made the way the generator is set up. Nothing is shown, and the clipboard is cleared as usual.
- *Codes* and *Favorites*: only with [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access) on, and only while the vault is open. Codes shows the codes chosen under [Codes on widgets](/guide/settings/widgets/#setting-widget-codes), and a tap copies one. Favorites shows a letter and a name for each favorite, and a tap opens it.

If Android ends WM Pass while a widget shows codes or names, the widgets are drawn locked again within a few minutes.
